turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Crime Cell. Your Aadhaar card has been flagged in connection with a narcotics smuggling case across state borders.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Narcotics? There must be some mistake, I am a retired teacher!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we are calling you, but the digital trail leads to your ID. Because this is a sensitive national security matter, you are now under digital arrest and must not hang up or tell anyone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I have never heard of this. Can I call my son?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you disclose this to anyone, it will be treated as tampering with evidence and we will send a team for a physical arrest immediately. Do you understand the seriousness?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, yes, I understand. Please tell me how to clear my name.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The court allows a verification process to prove your innocence. You need to transfer a security deposit to the government's safe account for clearance.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much money are you asking for?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a small verification fee of nine thousand five hundred rupees. Once the payment is reflected, your name will be cleared from the FIR.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I can do it, but can you send me a letter or something official first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is no time for letters in a digital arrest. Transfer the nine thousand five hundred rupees now or the police van will reach your house in ten minutes.
